主要内容: On April 19, 2012, and May 21, 2012, Imperial Capital Bancorp, Inc. filed unaudited reports for March and April 2012 with the OUST, as required by the OUST Guidelines. The reports are limited in scope, cover shorter periods than Exchange Act filings, and are prepared solely for compliance with bankruptcy court and code requirements. The financial information is preliminary and unaudited, and may exclude GAAP items. The company cautions against relying on the reports, which may be revised and are not indicative of future results. The company and Holdco Advisors L.P. previously filed a reorganization plan with the Bankruptcy Court, which may not fully pay creditors if confirmed. Imperial Capital Bancorp, Inc. reported that after paying unsecured creditors, no assets will be available for common stockholders. The company expects its common stock to be extinguished upon the plan's effectiveness. The report includes forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties. The attached reports are for informational purposes only and not subject to Exchange Act liabilities.
